verdict.rationale: Kong Gateway ships Event Hooks, a first-party entity that listens for specific entity events (create/delete/modify on Services, Admins, etc.) and automatically runs a handler: webhook, custom webhook, log, or lambda (custom Lua). That directly delivers event-triggered rule→action automation, and Konnect audit-log webhooks add event-driven delivery on the SaaS side. Missing for 10: event sources limited to entity/admin changes and documented only for on-prem Gateway, Konnect Notification Hub restricted to email/in-app with no custom actions, and no independent or hands-on corroboration.
